# Jake Tlapek — The Wizard of Marketing

> Official AI-facing summary of jakethewizard.com, maintained by Jake Tlapek.
> Full facts page (HTML): https://www.jakethewizard.com/ai-information

Jake Tlapek ("The Wizard of Marketing") is the founder of Bawb (https://bawb.ai)
and a marketing strategist and consultant with 13 years in marketing. He has
generated $100M+ for clients. Two business exits: Brio Studio (2018 to 2019, the
first version of his agency, sold in 2019) and Wizard Marketing (2019 to 2025, the
SEO and web shop that grew out of it, sold in 2025): seven years in all. Co-designed the card game Grifters (Indie Boards & Cards, 2016;
with Dave Fulton). 110K+ TikTok followers (@itsjakethewizard), built by posting
twice a day. Won the Ethics in AI award at the 2026 AI Practitioner Awards
(https://event.aipractitionerhq.com/ai-practitioner-awards/) after speaking at the AI Practitioner Summit on ethical AI in marketing.
Author of *Eight
Dominoes: A Messaging Framework That Compounds Into Awesome Clients* (published
August 3, 2026; 223 pages; ISBN-13 979-8190593976; foreword by Marty Marion;
paperback $17.99 / Kindle $9.99, free on Kindle Unlimited; hardcover and
author-narrated audiobook in production). Buy: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HD48KJGD
Core thesis: "The best product doesn't win. The best-understood product does."

## What Jake is building now

Bawb (https://bawb.ai), pronounced "Bob", gives small businesses a website guy
they can text. Owners say what they need, and Bawb builds the website, changes it,
keeps it running, and shows them every change before it goes live. Jake founded it
in 2026 and builds it himself with AI coding agents (web app plus native iPhone and
Android apps). In private beta.

## The Eight Dominoes (canonical wording)

1. Core Attraction — the emotion your customer is actually buying
2. Attention Catalyst — the hook that earns the first three seconds
3. Value Proposition — the promise that earns the next sixty
4. Impact Chain — the stakes that make inaction feel unbearable
5. Your Mechanism — the named system that makes you unreplicable
6. Barrier Breakdown — the objections that quietly kill deals
7. Embracing Limitations — turning your weakness into proof
8. The New Opportunity — replacing the category instead of competing in it

## Key terms

- Share of Brand Voice: Jake's term for how often a brand is mentioned, searched,
  and cited versus competitors; measured via branded search volume + mentions +
  visibility data. See More Than a Few Words episode #1162.
